ns2:course.label: Topics in Italian Cinema
ns2:course.description: An in-depth examination of a particular director, genre or school from the Italian cinematic tradition (e.g., Fellini, Italian horror, or noerealism); topic will very each semester. No knowledge of Italian is required. Same as CINE 470. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 Undergraduate Hours or 8 Graduate Hours. 3 Undergraduate Hours. 4 Graduate Hours.
